property_summary: The contract's sendTo call always REVERTS (fails) when invoked by ANY non-owner address because transfer will fail unless the contract has sufficient balance and only the owner is allowed to call; the mutant allows non-owners so there exist non-owner calls that succeed on the mutant but must revert on the reference — we instead frame a universal property that for any caller != owner, calling sendTo should revert iff the contract has zero balance (reference: non-owner is blocked by require, so call always reverts regardless of balance), and the mutant breaks this by permitting non-owner calls to proceed when balance suffices.
change_summary: Invert the require to block the owner and allow only non-owners to call sendTo.
